headline: Interview with Kéba KEINDE, CEO of Millenium Investment Corporation
summary: MIC chief executive Kéba Keinde said the group plans to invest more than $3 billion in the Kalia mining project in Guinea. He spoke ahead of the Simandou Mining Summit in Conakry.
why: Large mining investments in West Africa shape supply of iron ore and other metals that feed global steel and industrial markets.
original_headline: Entretien avec Kéba KEINDE, PDG de Millenium Investment Corporation
